name: mtaacare
description: Find verified household help near home in Kenya. Cloudflare Pages + Pages Functions + D1.

scripts.deploy: npm test && wrangler pages deploy --branch main
scripts.dev:setup: wrangler d1 execute mtaacare --local --file=schema.sql && wrangler d1 execute mtaacare --local --file=seed.sql
scripts.db:stats: wrangler d1 execute mtaacare --remote --command="SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM helps) AS helps, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM helps WHERE status='approved') AS approved, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM requests) AS requests"
scripts.secret: wrangler pages secret put ADMIN_TOKEN --project-name mtaacare
